sourceTitle: Generate longer AI videos with Omni 1.2 Flash in Google Vids at no cost.
originalTitle: Generate longer AI videos with Omni 1.2 Flash in Google Vids at no cost.

blocks.text: Google Vids, our video creation and editing tool, now runs on Google's newest video generation model: Omni 1.2 Flash. Starting today, anyone with a Google account or Google Workspace subscription can generate up to three 15-second videos per month in Vids at no cost.
blocks.zh: 谷歌维兹,我们的视频创作和编辑工具,现在运行在谷歌最新的视频生成模式上:奥姆尼1.2闪电侠.从今天开始任何拥有Google账户或Google Workspace订阅的用户都可以免费在Vids每月生成最多3个15秒的视频.
blocks.en: Google Vids, our video creation and editing tool, now runs on Google's newest video generation model: Omni 1.2 Flash. Starting today, anyone with a Google account or Google Workspace subscription can generate up to three 15-second videos per month in Vids at no cost.

blocks.text: With Omni 1.2 in Google Vids, you can now bring your ideas to life in so many more ways:
blocks.zh: 与Omni 1.2 在谷歌维兹,你现在可以用更多方式 将你的想法付诸实践:
blocks.en: With Omni 1.2 in Google Vids, you can now bring your ideas to life in so many more ways:

blocks.text: Create your product promos in one go. Produce professional, quick-turn social content and promotional materials without a single cut.
blocks.zh: 一次创建你的产品bauros。生产专业,快速转会的社会内容和宣传材料,没有单一的剪切.
blocks.en: Create your product promos in one go. Produce professional, quick-turn social content and promotional materials without a single cut.

blocks.text: Transform static imagery into engaging videos. Upload reference images from anything — a trip, a school project, or learning materials — and your characters and scenes will stay consistent, from the first frame to the last.
blocks.zh: 将静态图像转换成视频从任何东西上传参考图像——一次旅行,学校项目,或学习材料 - 和你的人物和场景将保持一致,从第一帧到最后一帧。
blocks.en: Transform static imagery into engaging videos. Upload reference images from anything — a trip, a school project, or learning materials — and your characters and scenes will stay consistent, from the first frame to the last.

blocks.text: Make clips that sound more natural. With improved speech narration, your social clips, concept explainers, and teaser videos feel like something you recorded yourself.
blocks.zh: 制作更自然的片段。随着语音描述的改进,你的社交剪辑,概念解释者,和嘲笑者视频 感觉像的东西 你录了自己。
blocks.en: Make clips that sound more natural. With improved speech narration, your social clips, concept explainers, and teaser videos feel like something you recorded yourself.

blocks.text: If you can describe it, you can make it. Try Google Vids out at vids.new.
blocks.zh: 如果你能描述出来,你可以做到这一点。试试Google Vids在vids. new.
blocks.en: If you can describe it, you can make it. Try Google Vids out at vids.new.
